summary: Six instant gimmes, then a real scramble for India, Argentina, Kazakhstan and Algeria, with Greenland, DR Congo and Saudi Arabia as traps. A strong daily that also makes a deep Blitz.
reasons: Curve is good: Russia to Australia are automatic, the last four take map thinking, and Algeria is the satisfying stretch
Near misses teach something: DR Congo #11, Saudi Arabia #12, Mexico #13; Greenland costs a life as a non-country, which stings but is a fair lesson
Casual Blitz scored 26 of 27 (only Greenland scored nothing); data matches the standard total-area ranking
fixes: 'aussie' is offered as a correction to Russia instead of Australia; add 'aussie' as an Australia alias or keep it out of fuzzy matching
